feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 October 2026 5:35am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 21 October 2026 at 5:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing, risk of gales for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and a shallow low over Ireland moving slowly northwards, bringing unsettled conditions and frontal systems across the area.


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 to 5, gradually veering west or northwest 5 to 7 during this morning, then increasing 6 or 7, perhaps locally gale 8 in the afternoon. Decreasing 5 or 6 into this evening, then 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate by mid-morning, then moderate or rough this afternoon. Falling mainly moderate this evening, then slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, clearing to isolated showers later this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, decreasing southwest 3 or 4 around midday Thursday, then gradually backing southeast during the afternoon. Increasing east or southeast 5 or 6 overnight into Friday, then backing northerly later.


##State of Sea##

Slight building moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain, heavy at times, arriving later Thursday evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers and rain later on.
